latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Feynman Technique Explainer skill

- Provides step-by-step explanations of any concept using the Feynman Technique.
- Strictly enforces a no-jargon rule; all explanations use plain language for accessibility.
- Uses a four-part structure: plain-language explanation, real-world analogy, concrete example, and a user quiz to test understanding.
- Includes guardrails to avoid over-complexity, jargon, and topic drift.
- Offers specific instructions on handling ambiguous or multi-concept requests.
